evidence: Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp and src/index/txindex.h to permit running txindex with -prune.
rationale: Enables running txindex concurrently with block pruning, resolving four long-standing user requests dating back to 2017 (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240). Previously, pruned node operators could not use txindex or service transaction lookups without storing the entire blockchain history on disk.
